text:
Mira Patel: FYI opened a PR to clarify polaris-13b model card: add CPU fallback note for quant builds, a small Go SDK snippet for embeddings, and an explicit limits row for embedding shard size. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/998
Jonah Reed: skimmed. Important: quantized CPU fallback behavior needs a clear user-facing sentence: when aurora-quant not supported, runtime falls back to polaris-13b-fp16 and may disable some kernel optimizations. Customers need to know perf/latency expectations.
Rohit Agarwal: Agreed. Also add a short perf row that says "quant-CPU fallback: higher latency, lower throughput" and point to the rebenchmark ticket.
Mira Patel: added the sentence and a parenthetical linking INF-2005 for re-runs on cpu-quant.
Lina Gomez: I can help with the Go snippet. Current doc shows JS/Python only. For embedding-heavy customers Go examples are helpful. I'll add a minimal snippet using sdk v1-go:```go
// create batched embeddings in Go
parts := splitText(doc, 4000)
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, schema.EmbeddingsCreateRequest{
  Model: "polaris-13b",
  Input: parts,
  BatchSize: 32,
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```
Jonah Reed: small nits: use `model: "polaris-13b-embed"` if we have an explicit embed-optimized variant; otherwise keep polaris-13b but mention variant name in compat table. Also Go SDK field names should be camelCase (BatchSize -> BatchSize).
Lina Gomez: fixed to polaris-13b-embed and verified camelCase; pushed commit.
Samira (docs-bot): running linkcheck & render check on branch lina/polaris-go-embed.
Rohit Agarwal: embedding sharding note: clarify recommended shard size (4k tokens) and mention vector store alignment (store shard_id and original_offset). One sentence under embedding guidelines should suffice.
Mira Patel: added a one-line recommendation and a tiny example comment showing storing shard metadata.
Jonah Reed: Benchmarks currently reference "measured on p4d, runtime v1.13". Please add a TODO to re-run on runtime v1.14 (kernel selection) and INF-2005 link.
Mira Patel: done. Also added a short callout: "Quantized CPU builds are experimental on <v1.14; expect performance variance".
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck found 1 broken anchor (old bench anchor). Suggest replace with /internals/benchmarks#polaris-13b.
Mira Patel: fixed link. Formatted markdown table blank-line issue also fixed.
Lina Gomez: I tested the Go snippet locally against a dev runtime; it works with Embeddings.Create call and the batch sizing. Added a tiny note about backoff when hitting rate limits.
Rohit Agarwal: add a compatibility matrix row: polaris-13b-aurora-quant -> fallback polaris-13b-fp16; note: embedding numerical variance after aggressive quantization.
Mira Patel: added the compat matrix row and a short recommendation: "Prefer polaris-13b-fp16 for embedding accuracy-sensitive workloads".
Samira (docs-bot): spellcheck & render checks passed after latest pushes. Merge window OK (02:00-09:00 UTC). No conflicts.
Jonah Reed: approving pending docs review. @docs-team please quick review the phrasing around CPU-quant fallback.
Mira Patel: pinged reviewers. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning after a final sanity pass.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Mira Patel at 4625008045. Changelog updated: "polaris-13b: Go embed snippet, CPU quant fallback note, embed shard guidance, bench link -> INF-2005"
Omar: great work, thanks all for the quick turnaround. Closing loop.
